title: The Commute — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth commute
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The commute is the time that nobody claims belongs to them
It's between the home and work — a no-man's land of hem
You're not at home and not at work and not at liberty
The commute is scheduled to be nobody's territory

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El trayecto es el tiempo que nadie reclama como suyo
[The commute is the time nobody claims as their own]
Está entre el hogar y el trabajo — tierra de nadie, cuyo
[It is between home and work — no-man's land, whose]
No estás en casa ni en el trabajo ni en libertad
[You are not at home nor at work nor at liberty]
El trayecto está programado para no tener identidad
[The commute is scheduled to have no identity]

[Chorus — English]
The commute knows something I don't know
It knows the particular rhythm of the face of those who go
The same route every morning in the same configuration
The commute is a ritual that predates the destination
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le trajet est le temps que personne ne revendique
[The commute is the time nobody claims]
Il est entre la maison et le travail — une zone unique
[It is between home and work — a unique zone]
Tu n'es ni chez toi ni au travail ni libre
[You are neither at home nor at work nor free]
Le trajet est programmé pour être le no man's land sobre
[The commute is scheduled to be the sober no man's land]

[Outro — All three languages]
The commute knows… El trayecto sabe… Le trajet sait
The in-between time thinks — El tiempo intermedio piensa — Le temps intermédiaire pense
That's my boy
